sources: Google Maps place 'Silver Sage RV Park', 314 E Main St, Rangely (read 2026-10-27)

values.note: Deluxe back-in and pull-through sites $35/day, Premium back-in (two sites combined) $40/day; the online booking pages show these with tax as 'From $37.98' / '$43.40 per night'. Long-term month-to-month spaces also offered.

fees.source: https://silversagerv.com/rates/ ('Deluxe Pull-Through Sites ... $35/Day', 'Deluxe Back-in Sites ... $35/Day', 'Premium Back-In Sites ... $40/Day') + https://silversagerv.com/product/deluxe-back-in-site/ (WooCommerce booking: 'From $ 37.98 per night', Premium 'From $ 43.40 per night'; page (c) 2026), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://silversagerv.com/rates/ ('All sites are full hookup and include 20-30-50 amp service'), read 2026-10-27

sites.source: https://silversagerv.com/rates/ ('Deluxe Pull-Through Sites (25'W X 90'L)'), read 2026-10-27. The stored 57-site count was derived from the sweep note and the operator gives no count, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: https://silversagerv.com/rates/ ('RVs must be fully contained and functional. Our RV park has no bathrooms, or showers. No dry camping. No on-site laundry facility') + https://silversagerv.com/ ('Free WiFi'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Book a site online on the park's own site (per night or month); if it shows no availability, call (970) 675-2259 to book manually. Check-in from 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://silversagerv.com/rates/ ('Reserve Now'; 'If our online reservation system shows no availability, call us (970-675-2259) and we can book your reservation manually'; 'Check-in is from 1:00pm') + product pages (Night(s)/Month booking form), read 2026-10-27

note: Big-rig-friendly in-town park (90-ft gravel pads, paved roads) on Main St, walkable to downtown. No restrooms at all, so rigs must be fully self-contained (no dry camping); pet-friendly. Near Dinosaur NM, Canyon Pintado, BLM OHV trails. Mixed transient/long-term park in an oil town (about half long-term/pipeline workers) but openly books overnight travelers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its own WooCommerce booking pages: $35 (deluxe back-in/pull-through) to $40 (premium) a day, full hookups 20/30/50 A, pull-throughs, no showers or laundry, free wifi, reservable online. Added flush_toilets false (the park has no bathrooms), booking platform/url. Cleared the 57-site count (sweep note only). Corrected the note's 'restrooms' (the operator says none).
flags: Phone: the operator's site shows two numbers, (970) 822-2719 in the header (also Google Maps') and (970) 675-2259 on the rates page footer and for manual bookings (the entry's). Either works per the site; consider 822-2719 as the main line.

Long-stay character (oilfield town, long-term month-to-month spaces 'up to a year or more'): the five tests pass - $35 posted nightly with phone and an online engine selling single nights, no minimum stated, no site counts to measure the transient share, and no homes or lots for sale (the linked silversageresidence.com is a separate home-rental property). Presence: own site + engine, Google Maps 4.5 / 46 reviews.
No bathrooms at all: the park takes only fully self-contained rigs (EKKO qualifies).
